result.topic_en: Scattered calculations: an algebraic expression in b, c, a; operator/derivative manipulations; ellipsoidal-coordinate-type integrals for x and y in terms of s, t, beta, gamma; and a potential-theory computation for a sphere of radius a (Poisson-type integral, jump condition -4πρ for the normal derivative).
